messages:
Ellen Park: Hi folks! Ellen here, starting today as Product Designer on onboarding. Primary asks: Figma access, canonical onboarding roadmap, where past usability clips + A/B test results live, and how to get test devices (iOS/Android) for QA. Shortest route?
Rory (DesignOps): Welcome Ellen :wave: Which email did you sign up with so I can invite you to the Design org and the crit calendar? Also we maintain a short "new-designer skim" doc with top files to open.
Ellen Park: ellen.park@redwood.com. A skim doc sounds ideal. Also any guidance on device lab booking?
Diego_IT: Okta should've provisioned you. If Figma invite missing try https://okta.redwood.com/apps -> Request Access -> Figma. Device lab: book via internal portal https://infra.redwood.com/device-lab (choose device_pool: onboarding). If the device doesn't appear, run `curl -X POST https://infra.redwood.com/devices/book -d '{"user":"ellen.park@redwood.com","pool":"onboarding"}' -H "Authorization: Bearer <token>"` and DM me the request id.
Rory (DesignOps): Sent Figma invite and added you to "Design - Onboarding" team. New-designer skim includes: Onboarding Components (library), Signup experiments board, and the onboarding research index. I'll DM the link.
Pri (Research): Research artifacts: raw sessions and clips in Dovetail (project: onboarding_tests). A/B test results repo is in Looker under Analytics > Experiments > onboarding. We also keep short experiment summaries in Notion under Research > Experiments with a TL;DR, confidence, and suggested next steps. For recruitment, email research@redwood.com or post to #participant-recruitment.
Ellen Park: Thanks! Where do engineers expect Figma links for visual QA? Storybook?
Maya (Design System): Storybook is at https://storybook.redwood.com and we mirror key components there. When you change a component, publish it to the DS library and add an entry in the Product Spec DB: include Figma file, component ID, and rollout notes. For tokens, accept the DS library to pull token values.
Sam (PM): Roadmap: Notion > Product > Roadmap > Onboarding initiative (quarter view). There's a pinned section with goals + open experiments. If you want a 20m overview, I have a slot today 3:30pm.
Ellen Park: 3:30 works, please add me. Also, I didn't get the Figma invite  checked spam.
Diego_IT: If invite didn't arrive try internal slack command: `/app-request figma ellen.park@redwood.com` or run `ssh into-accessbox && sudo assist resend-invite --app figma --email ellen.park@redwood.com` (internal tool). Ping me if you hit rate limits.
Rory (DesignOps): Quick onboarding tips: 1) accept DS library first, 2) skim Signup experiments board (filters: active + owner), 3) watch last two usability test clips (we pin the 90s highlights), 4) join #design-review and #product-ops.
setup-bot: Automated: added Ellen Park to "Design - Onboarding" Figma team and granted Notion read access (pending acceptance).
Pri (Research): If you want to shadow a live session we have one Wed 11am. Also note: when adding research notes to Notion use the "Experiment template" and include metrics, sample size, and a short recommendation.
Ellen Park: Got the Figma invite after resending, accepted the library, and booked a Pixel device for testing. Joining the 3:30 roadmap now. Thanks all :tada:
